mapper.sql: c.counter_id, c.counter_cd, c.counter_nm, c.target_type, c.equip_id, c.asset_id, coalesce(e.equip_cd, a.asset_cd) as target_cd, coalesce(e.equip_nm, a.asset_nm) as target_nm, coalesce(e.plant_cd, (select e2.plant_cd from mst_asset_install i join mst_equip e2 on e2.equip_id = i.equip_id where i.asset_id = c.asset_id and i.removed_at is null and i.void_yn = 'N' limit 1)) as plant_cd, c.counter_kind, c.unit_nm, c.scale, c.use_yn, c.remark, c.row_ver, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, a.life_shots, s.total, s.reading_cnt, (select count(*) from cms_pm_plan p where p.counter_id = c.counter_id and p.use_yn = 'Y') as plan_cnt, l.reading_id as last_reading_id, l.read_at as last_read_at, (select r.gauge_value from cms_counter_reading r where r.counter_id = c.counter_id and r.void_yn = 'N' and r.gauge_value is not null order by r.read_at desc, r.reading_id desc limit 1) as last_gauge

from cms_counter c left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = c.equip_id left join mst_phys_asset a on a.asset_id = c.asset_id left join lateral (select r.reading_id, r.read_at from cms_counter_reading r where r.counter_id = c.counter_id and r.void_yn = 'N' order by r.read_at desc, r.reading_id desc limit 1) l on true left join lateral (select coalesce(sum(r.delta_qty), 0) as total, count(*) as reading_cnt from cms_counter_reading r where r.counter_id = c.counter_id and r.void_yn = 'N') s on true -- 합·수를 한 번 훑기로(ix_cms_counter_reading_sum)

where.if: and (c.counter_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or c.counter_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\' or e.equip_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or a.asset_cd like #{keyword} escape '\')

c.counter_nm desc coalesce(e.equip_cd, a.asset_cd) desc nulls last c.counter_kind desc (select r.read_at from cms_counter_reading r where r.counter_id = c.counter_id and r.void_yn = 'N' order by r.read_at desc, r.reading_id desc limit 1) desc nulls last c.use_yn desc c.counter_cd desc ,
c.counter_id

c.counter_nm desc coalesce(e.equip_cd, a.asset_cd) desc nulls last c.counter_kind desc l.read_at desc nulls last c.use_yn desc c.counter_cd desc ,
c.counter_id
mapper.select:
select where c.counter_id in (select c.counter_id from cms_counter c left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = c.equip_id left join mst_phys_asset a on a.asset_id = c.asset_id
order by limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}) order by
select count(*) from cms_counter c left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = c.equip_id left join mst_phys_asset a on a.asset_id = c.asset_id
select counter_id from cms_counter where counter_id = #{id} for update

insert into cms_counter (comp_cd, counter_cd, counter_nm, target_type, equip_id, asset_id, counter_kind, unit_nm, scale, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{c.counterCd}, #{c.counterNm}, #{c.targetType}, #{c.equipId}, #{c.assetId}, #{c.counterKind}, #{c.unitNm}, #{c.scale}, #{c.useYn}, #{c.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning counter_id

select r.reading_id, r.read_at, r.gauge_value, r.delta_qty, r.reset_yn, r.source, r.remark, r.recorded_at, r.recorded_by, r.void_yn, r.void_reason, r.voided_by, r.voided_at, c.scale from cms_counter_reading r join cms_counter c on c.counter_id = r.counter_id where r.counter_id = #{counterId} and r.reading_id = #{readingId}

insert into cms_counter_reading (comp_cd, counter_id, read_at, gauge_value, delta_qty, reset_yn, source, remark, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{counterId}, #{readAt}, #{gauge}, #{delta}, #{resetYn}, 'MANUAL', #{remark}, #{by}) returning reading_id
mapper.update: update cms_counter_reading set void_yn = 'Y', void_reason = #{reason}, voided_by = #{by}, voided_at = now() where reading_id = #{readingId} and void_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(delta_qty), 0) from cms_counter_reading where counter_id = #{counterId} and void_yn = 'N'
select coalesce(sum(delta_qty), 0) from cms_counter_reading where counter_id = #{counterId} and void_yn = 'N' and read_at >= #{from}
